title: Timeline SDK closure expectations track the exported SIMD dependency

installed_sdk.rationale: The change updates the installed-consumer closure assertion; it does not add or alter an SDK header, target, symbol, or artifact.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No offline Timeline command, flag, handler, or document operation changes; only the CMake fixture expectation is corrected.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP operation or handler changes.

live_product_control.rationale: The test contract publishes no capability, operation, executor binding, grant, or policy.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: No design-time capability or agent manifest changes.
